sections.name: Recipe Hero
sections.style: light background with dark header area

contentSequences.description: Recipe image displayed prominently on the left side
Recipe title heading, star rating with review count, description paragraph, and meta info list (Total Time, Yield, Difficulty) in icon format
Dietary interests tags (Vegan, Vegetarian, Gluten-Free, etc.) and 'Submitted by: Vitamix' attribution

sections.name: Recipe Navigation
sections.style: light background with red accent underline

contentSequences.description: Horizontal navigation tabs (THE RECIPE, NUTRITIONAL FACTS, REVIEWS) with Cook Mode toggle switch on right
Action buttons row: Save, Print, Share icons with labels in dark background bar
Left sidebar: 'Refine Your Recipe' section with Container Size dropdown options (48-ounce, 64-ounce Low Profile)
Left sidebar: Nutrition table with serving size and values (Calories, Total Fat, Carbohydrate, Fiber, Sugars, Protein, Cholesterol, Sodium)
Main content: 'Ingredients' heading with Imperial/Metric toggle, bulleted list of 4 ingredients with amounts
Main content: 'Directions' heading with numbered steps (3 steps), carousel dots and prev/next navigation at bottom
Two side-by-side cards: Left card 'Did You Make It?' with 'Rate the Recipe' button, Right card 'Create Your Recipe Book' with 'Sign Up Now' button
'Reviews' heading with empty star rating display and 'Be the first to review this recipe' button
'What Else Did You Want To Make Today?' heading with search input field and SUBMIT button
'Popular Searches' heading with tag buttons: SOUP, HOLIDAY SEASON, SMOOTHIES
Eyebrow text 'EXPLORE VITAMIX PRODUCTS', heading 'Performance That Delivers', and 'SHOP NOW' button
Four product category cards in grid: Blenders, Food Processing, Containers & Accessories, Compact Food Recycling - each with product image and label
